sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is the edit target, Xiaoxiangguan from Dream of the Red Chamber. Preserve the EXACT three-bay small house, tile profile, open center bay and desk, timber windows, bent left corridor, background rear rooms, pear tree and banana, bamboo edge framing, camera and exquisite photoreal light. Correct ONLY the ground, water and excessive front flower plantings. The novel says the spring channel is barely one chi wide: approximately 25–35 CENTIMETERS. Replace ALL broad foreground and side pools with SOLID gently sloping mossy ground and a clearly continuous narrow pebble path to the front stairs. Leave only ONE delicate narrow stone-lined rill, 25–35 cm across, alongside the right wall and under bamboo, then briefly across the foreground edge. It must read as a tiny drainage-sized garden spring, NOT a pond, moat, lake, brook or island house. Remove ALL cascades and waterfalls, replace their drop with a modest shallow inlet in the rear wall at ground level. No broad water directly before the house, no bridge across a pool. Reduce pink flowering shrubs in the front courtyard; bamboo, moss and stone should dominate. Keep rear pear blossom as in the image. No added structures or people, no text, no major color or camera changes. Beautiful realistically buildable land-based residence, extremely clear masonry and ground continuity. ONE landscape image.
